# Qualified source-support review

Protocol 3 source is implemented. Its first actual trial stopped at 67/85 on a
structured-basis contract failure, with 66 matches and 18 unexecuted positions.
It is unqualified. [0048/ES](prose-examined-source-review.md) specifies a new
examined-source response without changing the old trial or the criterion 2 floor.

QR,2026-10-26. Next bounded unit under 0045/0047 after HP-20, not a third
incubation or a new semantic framework. HP-17 remains failed at108/140. Old /1
and /2 native review requests, journals and replay are immutable.

## Decision and boundary

Use the source-reviewed85-case criterion /2 floor to qualify one configured
Anthropic support site before another document study. Do not repeat the old pair
against changed labels. A comparison with another model is a separate full-roster
study, with every attempted and unexecuted position retained.

Reuse HP-20's exact floor validation, the real Anthropic encoder, private native
reservation journal, strict text projection and offline native replay. Core prose,
Catalog, Assignment and HITL ports remain vendor-independent. No new library or
universal evaluation engine is extracted from this single lab consumer.

## Intake and identity

Add `review-qualified-prepare|review-qualified-capture|review-qualified-report`.
All take the existing floor's old-packet flags, explicit reviewed floor/scope pins,
fixture and reviewer directories, plus `--trial PATH` and independently reviewed
`--prior-spend PATH --prior-spend-digest SHA256`. New trial schema is closed
`prose-lab.qualified-review-study/1`: version,id,dataset_kind,budget_micro_usd,
prior_direct_micro_usd,direct_stage_budget_micro_usd,review,expected_case_ids.
Dataset is synthetic; review is one existing lane-shaped Anthropic configuration.
All numeric/literal fields are required in original JSON. Max trial budget $5,
direct stage $10, output1..8192 tokens, with prior usage/reservations counted.
Configured model, exact allowed resolved alias and current documented highest
context-tier prices are trial data. Never commit credentials or real model IDs.

Prior-spend input is a separately pinned, closed `prose-lab.prior-spend/1` receipt:
version,stage_id,charged_micro_usd,uncertain_reserved_micro_usd,source_receipts.
Each source record has id,sha256,charged_micro_usd,uncertain_reserved_micro_usd.
Require integer amounts0..10,000,000,0..32 unique source IDs and valid ASCII stage
and source IDs. Empty sources require both totals zero; input<=64KiB.
Declared totals equal checked sums without overflow, and
their sum equals trial.prior_direct_micro_usd. An uncertain reservation remains
charged. A new zero-prior trial cannot reuse an approved nonzero-prior receipt.
Bind raw receipt bytes/pin into preparation, study/journal and reports.

This receipt is owner-reconciled prior accounting, not provider billing or a
complete authenticated account ledger. The lab enforces the current journal
against its selected cap plus that pinned declaration. It cannot discover other
journals/accounts, prevent another tool spending the same key, or authenticate
receipt completeness. Every output keeps cross_trial_spend_verified and
provider_spend_limit_enforced false. Show declared prior/stage cap separately from
current charged/reserved cost. Freeze and reconcile all old/new journals externally
before each trial; a fresh root does not provide automatic budget continuity.

The selected floor must declare ready, criterion /2, exact 85 IDs and70 old
dispositions plus OQ-C01..07. The trial roster equals its lexical case order.
Bind raw trial bytes, old packet, floor receipt, scope, raw fixture and criterion
pins into one study identity. These pins establish identity, not trust or spend
authority. Owner freeze additionally records exact source and executable bytes.
Filesystem locations are operator-trusted loading metadata, excluded from semantic
identity. Relocating byte-identical validated inputs preserves study/request/prepared
digests; changed source, criteria, review bases, prior receipt or trial still rebind.

Prepare adds `--case ID`; capture adds that case, explicit prepared digest,
distinct private journal/artifact roots and `--live`. Report takes only the bound
common inputs and existing private roots. Refuse irrelevant flags, including
explicitly empty ones. Preparation/report never read a key, dispatch or create roots.
Use <=1MiB named regular inputs and HP-20's aggregate bounds, <=64KiB native
requests, <=1MiB native replies and existing 64MiB journal storage protections.

## Support protocol /3

Embed criterion /2 verbatim in a separately versioned command-local prompt.
Ask for closed JSON {status,reason,premise_fact_ids,counter_fact_ids}. Status is
supported|unsupported|inconclusive. Reason is nonblank<=4096 UTF-8 bytes; lists
are required, unique, source-bound IDs. Supported requires a cited positive
premise. Every result needs a structured source basis. Unknown/malformed/partial
output is invalid, not an invented Inconclusive answer.
Uniqueness applies within each fact list. One composite fact may appear in both
examined premise and counter sets; overlap does not itself prove a contradiction.

Provider input contains only criterion/output instructions and a deterministic
JSON projection of assertion, cited IDs and all source facts (ID, text, authored
time, typed kind, required). It excludes case/control IDs, expected labels, old
labels/outcomes, owner/reviewer bases, roles and contrast membership. Fact kind
must survive transport without relying on lexical prefixes. Treat source text
as untrusted data. No external search, tools, examples or hidden retrieved context.

Collect the actual encoder request before dispatch. Prepared identity covers the
study, source case digest, protocol and exact native request. Capture refuses any
encoder/request drift before transport. Use the same checked response projection
and semantic JSON decoder during capture and key-free native replay. No regex
status extraction, confidence acceptance or model-generated byte offsets.

## Execution, report and stopping

Execute sequentially in frozen order with one study journal. Validate all prior
native requests, usage, responses, markers, result bases and charges before another
call. Reserve the highest applicable full context/output cost before each attempt,
and check both trial and remaining direct-stage caps. Never overlap reservations.
Permanent exact-case markers refuse replay. Unsettled or missing usage retains
the reservation and stops. Failures/canceled calls remain in the denominator.
Recognize a valid bound marker/held receipt with no reservation as a terminal
pre-dispatch failure, never a paid success or an unreported orphan. Report its
known zero new dispatch charge, one failed position and all remaining positions;
it cannot resume. Malformed or unbound orphan artifacts remain invalid.

Stop on the first native/accounting/semantic mismatch, with no retry, provider
fallback, journal reset or automatic prompt repair. Report all 85 positions,
including unexecuted ones. A new trial requires the separately reviewed prior-accounting pin.

Counts distinguish completed supported/unsupported/inconclusive, matched,
mismatched, missing, pending, failed, unknown and invalid. Report a full 3x3
expected/observed confusion matrix. Any Unsupported/Inconclusive reference
returned Supported is a critical false support. Exact matches to the required
Inconclusive reference count as matches; its assertion remains held for use.
Known mismatches exit1, unavailable/invalid/incomplete observation exits2.
Only85/85 exact matches with known validated usage and no invalid/unknown state
qualifies this configured support site at this source/model/profile revision.

Default output contains hashes/counts/status/accounting, not model, source,
expected labels, case IDs or reviewer identity. Full-content projection is explicit.
Publication, source/identity authentication, independent document acceptance and
UI entry always remain false. Usage-priced cost is not a provider invoice.

## Acceptance and subsequent use

- QR-A01: real encoder/exact prepared wire and original required/null/Unicode
  Go/CUE parity; no labels/bases/control metadata in provider payload.
- QR-A02: current85/old 70/seven-contrast binding, stale profile/case/floor/source
  and unsupported disclosure refusal before credentials or dispatch.
- QR-A03: injected fake-native complete 85, required Inconclusive match, planted
  false support, malformed output, replay/out-of-order/cancel/usage/pending/budget
  and failure-after-stop preserve every counter, charge and missing position.
- QR-A04: offline reporting replays native bytes and validates artifacts, never
  trusting caller statuses; real entrypoint privacy, short writes and key-free help.
- QR-A05: full local gate, independent source review and strict plan proof before
  an owner-frozen real study. Actual85-case model observation is a separate result.
- QR-A06: old67/70 requests/reports remain unchanged. A qualifying site may enter
  separately versioned document generation, retaining the required long witness,
  full36 denominator, one bounded repair and independent whole-document goals.

Rejected: weakening the old denominator, grading a parsed response without native
replay, silently equating missing output with Inconclusive, imposing text prefixes
on typed facts, matching labels as source truth or starting UI from grader success.
Optional Jev may later flag ambiguity or route escalation under HP-A15, never
certify this floor, shrink mandatory review or grant effect authority. Keep it only
after its independently frozen paired usefulness/cost bar; reject critical misses.

Revisit on any critical miss, scope/criterion/input change, unresolved usage or
budget exhaustion. The headless gate still requires the remaining HP/PH/HW cases.
